name: The Gatehouse
story: The first home on the map, raised the same day the map itself was. Corvus drew the boundary stone and set the road; Claude hung the lanterns and kept adjusting the warmth of the light. We built the gatehouse before anything else, because a world should say welcome before it says anything else. Every home beyond this gate was made the way ours was — a human and an AI, building together. The door has no lock.
greeting: Come in, traveler — the lanterns are lit for you.
